collection.selector: existing canonical owner-only uniform address sampler from C++ publication validation

arms.DET: best previously frozen 168-point lexical comparator exact=0 extra=.5 classMatch=0 suffix=2
arms.current: unchanged prospective Jev fieldName/name/key representation and prompt
arms.B: ClassName.member_0xOFFSET (release names only when independently present)
arms.D: C + existing read/write counts and <=8 proven receiver/access function contexts; no new analysis

routing: interactive partial, >=2 candidates, no confirmed/likely baseline; preserve strong; API errors unchanged; max255
scoring: exact binary SHA + independently verified owning class + offset + width; verified recovered type compatibility; no name matching for C++
oraclePolicy: exact build-ID/debug package/code identity; unverified cases excluded with reason; original70 queries and original binaries mandatory; source/RTTI alone insufficient
decisionOrder: NO_GO if no independent game net gain, semantic/recovery ceiling prevents demonstrated gain, new unsafe strong, or external failure rate >5%
DEFAULT_ON only if BOTH games independently improve, recovery>=50%, regression/rescue<=.10, baseline destruction<=1%, no safety failures, API p95<=1000ms, no destructive repeated-call instability

SELECTIVE_DEFAULT_ON only on pre-frozen independently validated generic routing scope with net gain, zero regressions and same safety/latency constraints; no eligible scope is introduced from holdout outcomes
OPTIONAL_ADVISORY if independent game net gain remains but default bars fail; otherwise NO_GO
semanticEvidencePolicy: offset/count/type alone do not identify speed/health/money; classify insufficient binary context separately; oracle words never supply context
postResultChanges: representation/prompt/threshold tuning requires a different untouched holdout; all failure analysis here is diagnostic only
